fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: A short label users and administrators recognize.
fields.protocolHint: Changes the WebSocket address between secure wss and unencrypted ws.
fields.websocketUrlHint: The address the browser connects to, for example wss://pbx.example.com:8089/ws.
fields.sipDomainHint: The domain users register under, for example pbx.example.com.
fields.enabledHint: When on, user phones can register and place calls through this server.
fields.realmHint: The SIP authentication realm; leave empty to use the SIP domain.
fields.fromDomainHint: The domain sent in the SIP From header; leave empty to use the SIP domain.
fields.registrarServerHint: The sip: URI used for SIP REGISTER requests when different from the domain.
fields.outboundProxyHint: The sip: URI of an outbound proxy to route SIP messages through.
fields.contactUriHint: An explicit SIP Contact URI if your PBX requires a fixed contact address.
fields.defaultCallerIdHint: The fallback outbound number when a user has no caller ID set.
fields.registerExpiresHint: How often the phone refreshes its registration, in seconds (30 to 86400).
fields.sessionTimersHint: Keeps active calls alive and detects dropped calls using SIP session timers.
fields.defaultTimeoutSecondsHint: Seconds to wait for this server before trying the next one (3 to 120; empty uses 10).
fields.defaultMaxRetriesHint: How many times to retry this server before moving on (0 to 10; empty uses 2).
fields.traceSipHint: Prints raw SIP messages in the browser developer console for troubleshooting.
fields.allowInvalidTlsCertificateHint: Flags self-signed servers; browsers still require a trusted certificate for wss:// connections.
fields.iceEnabledHint: Enables STUN and TURN servers for NAT traversal during media setup.
fields.iceTransportPolicyHint: Relay only sends all media through a TURN server.

ice.kindHint: Choose STUN for address discovery or TURN to relay media.
ice.enabledHint: Include this ICE server when establishing call media.
ice.urlsHint: Enter one STUN or TURN URL per line, starting with stun:, stuns:, turn:, or turns:.
ice.usernameHint: The TURN account username paired with the credential.
ice.credentialHint: Stored write-only on the server; leave blank to keep the existing credential.

validation.retriesRange: Must be a whole number from 0 to 10
validation.iceUrlsRequired: Enter at least one ICE URL

validation.turnUsernameRequired: Username is required when a credential is set
validation.turnCredentialRequired: Credential is required when a username is set
validation.stunNoAuth: STUN servers cannot have a username or credential
validation.relayWithoutTurn: Relay only needs at least one enabled TURN server.
